292696191_a9f5bf56.text: Molecular characterization of the 153 identified spinal-projecting neurons revealed that 46.4% expressed Oxt , establishing oxytocinergic neurons as the predominant genotype among PVN neurons capable of engaging spinal autonomic circuitry (Figure 2K )

292696191_d6cbf2c7.text: .Critically, spatial mapping of each cluster's somatic distribution within the PVN demonstrated that Cluster 1, 3, and 4 neurons were preferentially concentrated within the medial and posterior PVN (Figure 2L ), whereas Cluster 0 was anteriorly biased and Cluster 2 was distributed across the rostrocaudal extent.
